name: SafeTitan
summary: SafeTitan from TitanHQ pairs story-based lessons of about 8 to 10 minutes with automated phishing simulations that give each user unique lures. Its Report Manager has a User Completion Summary showing modules assigned and finished. TitanHQ publishes no price and says pricing depends on the number of users or modules.

facts.text: TitanHQ describes story-based lessons that run about 8 to 10 minutes and a Reactive Training feature that targets users who show insecure behavior.
Each user receives unique lures, and Auto Campaigns run continuously at no additional cost.
The User Completion Summary report shows how many campaigns each user was in, how many modules were assigned, how many were finished on time and the completion percentage.
TitanHQ says pricing is based on the number of users or modules required, with flexible subscription options.
